description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Colombo Port City (Duty Free Operations) Rules No. 01 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Colombo Port City Economic Commission under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for duty-free operations, including permitted goods, quantities, allowances, and transaction procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it creates subsidiary legislation under an existing Act.
